method: Public HTTPS GET of exact catalogue movie URLs, watch page, QA and app assets, with Cache-Control:no-cache. Whole returned MP4 bodies were hashed. No browser or learner writes were performed in this live delivery check.

page_delivery.interpretation: The live site was still serving a previous coherent edition. The T16.3 mismatch needs deployment of the committed corrected media, not another render.

queued_t181_production.integration_rule: Keep the current live T18.1 assignment until the checked movie, VTT, QA, poster and catalogue/watch-page versions are installed together. The staged local b06f8c… identity is not proof of a later CI export identity.

prevented_regression.cause: Both queued notebook and native-chapter installers update the catalogue and watch pages without updating the app edition map.
prevented_regression.change: The learner resolver prefers a declared catalogue URL only for the 72 known T01–T18 IDs and exact media/<same-id>.mp4?v=<safe-revision> paths. Invalid nonempty declarations fail closed. Existing approved fallbacks remain for blank legacy entries.
prevented_regression.negative_control: The previous resolver passes current catalogue checks but fails the new-edition test at T01.1.

acceptance_limit: These results verify HTTP delivery and resolver behavior. They do not confer full moving-picture and audible editorial approval or physical-device acceptance.
